idea-plugin.name: Aura Veyra
idea-plugin.description:
Your coding aura ✨ Farm it, flex it, share it.

Every time you clear your errors, ship a commit or get your tests green, your aura goes up. Leave a wip commit message or a debugger statement? That's a minus 💀. Rank up from NPC to Final Boss, keep your 🔥 streak alive, and share your aura card.

How to farm aura

  • 🧹 +15 clear every error in a file
  • 📦 +20 ship a commit, ✍️ +5 with a commit message that eats (feat: add dark mode)
  • ✅ +20 tests pass in the IDE's test runner, 🏗️ +10 build passes
  • ✂️ +15 delete 50+ lines, 🔒 +10 every 25 minutes locked in, 💾 +1 clean save
  • 🔥 +5 per day of your streak, 🦉 +5 coding after midnight

Roast mode (turn it off any time): −5 for "wip" commit messages, −5 failing tests, −3 failed builds, −5 a leftover debugger. Every move has a daily limit, so aura can't be farmed by spamming saves.

Ranks

🧍 NPC → 🎭 Side Character → ✨ Main Character → 🔒 Locked In → 🗿 Sigma → 🌾 Aura Farmer → 🐐 Goated → 👑 Final Boss

What you get

  • Your aura and streak in the status bar, with each move as it happens.
  • The Aura tool window: your rank and progress, streak, the week as a chart, your best moves and every move.
  • Share My Aura Card: a 1200 × 630 image for X, LinkedIn and Instagram, with the caption copied.
  • A notification when you rank up.

Private

Aura only counts what the IDE already sees on your computer: errors, saves, commits (from Git, however you make them), test runs and builds. It's stored with your IDE settings. No account, no telemetry.

Open it from View → Tool Windows → Aura or click your aura in the status bar. Works in every JetBrains IDE: IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, PhpStorm, Rider, CLion, RubyMine and RustRover.
Made by FlightCoders, the team behind Veyra Studio. Also for VS Code, as Veyra Aura.
